12: A three-term geometric sequence with positive terms is given: $(81,\ 3x,\ 4)$. It follows that: A. $x=18$  B. $x=6$  C. $x=\frac{85}{6}$  D. $x=\frac{6}{85}$
13: The angle $\alpha$ is acute and satisfies $\sin\alpha=\dfrac{2\sqrt6}{7}$. It follows that: A. $\cos\alpha=\frac{24}{49}$  B. $\cos\alpha=\frac{5}{7}$  C. $\cos\alpha=\frac{25}{49}$  D. $\cos\alpha=\frac{5\sqrt6}{7}$

15: In triangle $ABC$ point $D$ lies on side $BC$ and point $E$ lies on side $AC$. Segment $DE$ is parallel to side $AB$, and moreover $|AE|=|DE|=4$, $|AB|=6$ (see figure). The length of segment $CE$ equals: A. $\frac{16}{3}$  B. $\frac{8}{3}$  C. 8  D. 6
16: An equilateral triangle has area equal to $6\sqrt3$. The side of this triangle has length: A. $3\sqrt2$  B. $2\sqrt3$  C. $2\sqrt6$  D. $6\sqrt2$

27: Solve the equation $(x^2-6)(3x+2)=0$. (sum of all solutions)
30: From the set of numbers $\{1,2,4,5,10\}$ two numbers are drawn, one at a time, with replacement. Compute the probability of event $A$: that the quotient of the first drawn number divided by the second drawn number is an integer.
31: The arithmetic sequence $(a_n)$, defined for $n\ge1$, satisfies $a_{21}+a_{24}+a_{27}+a_{30}=100$. Compute the sum $a_{25}+a_{26}$.

33: The point $C=(0,0)$ is a vertex of right triangle $ABC$, whose vertex $A$ lies on the $Ox$ axis, and vertex $B$ lies on the $Oy$ axis of the coordinate system. Compute the coordinates of vertices $A$ and $B$ of this triangle, and the length of the hypotenuse $AB$. (sum of all computed numbers)
34: The base of a right prism $ABCDEF$ is a right triangle $ABC$ in which $|\angle ACB|=90^\circ$ (see figure). The ratio of the length of leg $AC$ of this triangle to the length of leg $BC$ equals $4:3$. Point $S$ is the center of the circle circumscribed on triangle $ABC$, and the length of segment $SC$ equals 5. The area of lateral face $BEFC$ of the prism equals 48. Compute the volume of this prism.
